$comment: LinkML version: linkml-model 1.8.x. Vendored subset of the LinkML metamodel for the authored ErDefinition body element. Compiled by the shared ajv singleton (structured-output.ts, draft 2020-12 semantics; the $schema meta-schema declaration is intentionally omitted so the shared ajv instance compiles it with no external meta-schema fetch). Pinned so the ER JSON element is validated with ajv and NO Python/LinkML toolchain runs at daemon runtime (k5). Models ClassDefinition (classes) whose slots are SlotDefinitions with LinkML cardinality (required/multivalued/minimum_cardinality/maximum_cardinality), a range (scalar type = attribute, another class = relationship), and an identifier flag.
title: ErDefinition (LinkML metamodel subset)

classes.description: The entities of the data model, keyed by class name. Each value is an ErClass.

ErClass.description: A LinkML ClassDefinition subset — an entity with named slots.

attributes.description: The class's slots, keyed by slot name. Each value is an ErSlot.

ErSlot.description: A LinkML SlotDefinition subset. A `range` naming a scalar type is an attribute; a `range` naming another class is a relationship. Cardinality follows LinkML (required/multivalued or the explicit minimum/maximum_cardinality).

range.description: The slot's type: a scalar type name (attribute) or a class name defined in `classes` (relationship).

required.description: LinkML `required`: the slot must be present (minimum cardinality >= 1).

multivalued.description: LinkML `multivalued`: the slot may hold many values (maximum cardinality > 1).

identifier.description: LinkML `identifier`: this slot uniquely identifies an instance of the class.
